persona: Infrastructure team lead who has led a data-centre move
resumeText:
Vikram Malhotra | Gurugram | vikram.malhotra@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Infrastructure Team Lead, Aravalli IT Services, Gurugram (2017 - present)
- Led a team of 9 engineers running servers and networks for a retail client.
- Planned the move of 220 servers to a new data centre with an MS Project schedule.
- Kept a RAID log for the migration and escalated risks to the client sponsor.
- Managed the hardware vendor and the cabling partner against the agreed statement of work.
- Ran weekly steering meetings with the client IT head and business owners.
- Sent weekly status reports to the account manager and client.
- Ran the operations team in two-week sprints on Jira.

Network Engineer, Yamuna Netcom, Delhi (2013 - 2017)
- Configured Cisco switches and firewalls for branch offices.

SKILLS
Project management, MS Project, Jira, ITIL, Excel

EDUCATION
BTech Electronics, Delhi Technological University, 2013
